files.legend.sop:
@legend.core core.legend
    namespace=core
    version=0.1.0
    doc="Bootstrap legend: the types and keys every other legend builds on. Dynamic keys: a core.key with dynamic=true declares a key prefix; a wire may use any key of the form <prefix>.<anything> (for example where.owner or arg.count on core.question and core.request). The part after the prefix is resolved against the wire type named by the question, and the value kind is any."

@core.thing core.type
    doc="Root of the type hierarchy; any wire without an explicit parent extends it."

@core.state core.type
    extends=core.thing
    doc="A fact that holds at some time: something has a property or relation."

@core.event core.type
    extends=core.thing
    doc="Something that happens; events are ordered by core.seq in dialog order."

@core.agent core.type
    extends=core.thing
    doc="A person or participant that can be mentioned in dialog."
    example="Tom"

@core.question core.type
    extends=core.thing
    doc="A question about a wire type: type, seek, optional where.<key> constraints (see the legend doc), mode."

@core.answer core.type
    extends=core.thing
    doc="The result of resolving a question or request, written by the interpreter."

@core.request core.type
    extends=core.thing
    doc="A request to run an action operation: action and optional arg.<name> arguments (see the legend doc)."

@core.legend core.type
    extends=core.thing
    doc="A legend: namespace, version, imports."

@core.type core.type
    extends=core.thing
    doc="A type declaration."

@core.key core.type
    extends=core.thing
    doc="A key declaration."

@core.world core.type
    extends=core.thing
    doc="A world manifest."

@core.pattern core.type
    extends=core.thing
    doc="A rule-formalizer pattern."

@core.operation core.type
    extends=core.thing
    doc="An operation declaration."

@core.template core.type
    extends=core.thing
    doc="An answer rendering template."

@core.test core.type

@core.lexicon core.type

@core.note core.type

files.patterns.sop:
@pat.docs.editor.heading core.pattern
    match="[can_you|could_you|will_you|would_you|please_can_you]? [add|insert|create|write|put_in] [a|the|another]? [heading|header|subheading] [saying|called|named|that_says|reading]? {t:rest}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=doc.addHeading arg.text=\"{t}\""
    kind=request
    priority=11
    example="Add a heading Shopping."

@pat.docs.editor.paragraph core.pattern
    match="[can_you|could_you|will_you|would_you|please_can_you]? [add|insert|type|write|put_in|append] [a|the|another|one_more]? [paragraph|line|sentence|note] [saying|that_says|reading|with_the_text|with]? {t:rest}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=doc.addParagraph arg.text=\"{t}\""
    kind=request
    priority=11
    example="Add a paragraph The cat sat on the mat."

@pat.docs.editor.list core.pattern
    match="[can_you|could_you|will_you|would_you|please_can_you]? [add|insert|create|make|write|put_in] [a|the|another]? [list|bullet_list|bulleted_list] [with|of|containing|including]? {t:rest}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=doc.addList arg.text=\"{t}\""
    kind=request
    priority=11
    example="Add a list with milk, eggs and bread."

@pat.docs.editor.bare core.pattern
    match="[can_you|could_you|will_you|would_you|please_can_you]? [type|write_down|note_down|put_down] {t:rest}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=doc.addParagraph arg.text=\"{t}\""
    kind=request
    priority=5
    example="Type remember to buy milk."

@pat.docs.editor.delete.ord core.pattern
    match="[can_you|could_you|will_you|would_you|please_can_you]? [delete|remove|erase|drop|get_rid_of] [the|my]? {ord:lex.docs.editor.ordinals} {kind:lex.docs.editor.kinds}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=doc.delete arg.ord={ord} arg.kind={kind}"
    kind=request
    priority=11
    example="Delete the last paragraph."

@pat.docs.editor.delete.num core.pattern
    match="[can_you|could_you|will_you|would_you|please_can_you]? [delete|remove|erase|drop|get_rid_of] [the|my]? {kind:lex.docs.editor.kinds} {n:number}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=doc.delete arg.n={n} arg.kind={kind}"
    kind=request
    priority=11
    example="Delete paragraph 2."

@pat.docs.editor.delete.bare core.pattern
    match="[can_you|could_you|will_you|would_you|please_can_you]? [delete|remove|erase|drop|get_rid_of] [the|my]? {kind:lex.docs.editor.kinds}"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=doc.delete arg.ord=first arg.kind={kind}"
    kind=request
    priority=10
    example="Delete the paragraph."

@pat.docs.editor.delsent core.pattern
    match="[can_you|could_you|will_you|would_you|please_can_you]? [delete|remove|erase] [the]? [last|previous] sentence"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=doc.deleteSentence"
    kind=request
    priority=11
    example="Delete the last sentence."

@pat.docs.editor.clear core.pattern
    match="[can_you|could_you|will_you|would_you|please_can_you]? [clear|empty|erase|wipe|reset|delete|remove] [the|my]? [document|text|page|doc|everything]"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=doc.clear"
    kind=request
    priority=11
    example="Clear the document."

@pat.docs.editor.replace core.pattern

    version=0.1.0
    imports=core
    imports=kids.common
    doc="Animals and their properties, and the pets a child tells about"

@kids.animals.animal core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="Facts about one kind of animal. Several wires may describe the same kind (knowledge base and things taught in the dialog); their keys are merged."
    example="A spider has 8 legs."
    example="Zebras eat grass."
    negative="Tom has 8 apples."

@kids.animals.animal.name core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Which kind of animal is it?"

@kids.animals.animal.class core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Which class is it (mammal, bird, fish, insect, reptile, amphibian, arachnid ...)?"

@kids.animals.animal.legs core.key
    value=integer
    ask="How many legs does it have?"

@kids.animals.animal.diet core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Is it a herbivore, a carnivore or an omnivore?"

@kids.animals.animal.food core.key
    value=string
    ask="What does it eat?"
    card=many

@kids.animals.animal.habitat core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Where does it live (farm, forest, sea, river, jungle, desert, polar, home ...)?"
    card=many

@kids.animals.animal.covering core.key
    value=atom
    ask="What covers its body (fur, feather, scale, skin, shell ...)?"
    card=many

@kids.animals.animal.sound core.key
    value=string
    ask="Which sound does it make?"

@kids.animals.animal.baby core.key
    value=atom
    ask="What is its baby called?"

@kids.animals.animal.can_fly core.key
    value=boolean
    ask="Can it fly?"
    compute=true

@kids.animals.animal.can_swim core.key
    value=boolean
    ask="Can it swim?"
    compute=true

@kids.animals.animal.is_a core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Which class or diet is asked about (for yes/no questions)?"
    compute=true
    observe=false

@kids.animals.animal.lives core.key
    value=string
    ask="Where does it live?"
    compute=true
    observe=false

@kids.animals.animal.covered core.key
    value=string
    ask="What is its body covered in?"
    compute=true
    observe=false

@kids.animals.animal.summary core.key
    value=string
    ask="What is it like?"
    compute=true
    observe=false

@kids.animals.animal.matching core.key
    value=string
    ask="Which animals match the given properties?"
    card=many
    compute=true
    observe=false

@kids.animals.pet core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="A pet that a person tells about: its kind and its name."
    example="My dog is called Rex."
    negative="A dog has 4 legs."

@kids.animals.pet.owner core.key
    value=$core.agent
    ask="Whose pet is it?"

@kids.animals.pet.kind core.key
    value=atom
    ask="What kind of animal is the pet?"

@kids.animals.pet.called core.key
    value=$core.agent
    ask="What is the pet called?"

files.operations.sop:
@op.kids.animals.canFlyYes core.operation
    outputs=kids.animals.animal.can_fly
    inputs=kids.animals.animal.name
    impl=canFlyYes
    semantics=query
    doc="Yes when some statement says the animal can fly; conflicting when statements disagree; missing when nothing is stated."

@op.kids.animals.canFlyNo core.operation
    outputs=kids.animals.animal.can_fly
    inputs=kids.animals.animal.name
    impl=canFlyNo
    semantics=query
    doc="No only when a statement explicitly says the animal cannot fly (refuted); otherwise missing (unknown)."

@op.kids.animals.canSwimYes core.operation
    outputs=kids.animals.animal.can_swim
    inputs=kids.animals.animal.name
    impl=canSwimYes
    semantics=query
    doc="Yes when some statement says the animal can swim."

@op.kids.animals.canSwimNo core.operation
    outputs=kids.animals.animal.can_swim
    inputs=kids.animals.animal.name
    impl=canSwimNo
    semantics=query
    doc="No only when a statement explicitly says the animal cannot swim."

@op.kids.animals.isAYes core.operation
    outputs=kids.animals.animal.is_a
    inputs=kids.animals.animal.name
    inputs=kids.animals.animal.is_a
    impl=isAYes
    semantics=query
    doc="Yes when the animal has the asked class or diet; conflicting when several classes are stated."

@op.kids.animals.isANo core.operation
    outputs=kids.animals.animal.is_a
    inputs=kids.animals.animal.name
    inputs=kids.animals.animal.is_a
    impl=isANo
    semantics=query
    doc="No, with the actual class or diet, when the animal is known to have another one."

@op.kids.animals.livesWhere core.operation
    outputs=kids.animals.animal.lives
    inputs=kids.animals.animal.name
    impl=livesWhere
    semantics=query
    doc="A phrase telling where the animal lives, from all its habitats."

@op.kids.animals.coveredIn core.operation
    outputs=kids.animals.animal.covered
    inputs=kids.animals.animal.name
    impl=coveredIn
    semantics=query
    doc="A phrase telling what covers the animal body."

@op.kids.animals.describeAnimal core.operation
    outputs=kids.animals.animal.summary
    inputs=kids.animals.animal.name
    impl=describeAnimal
    semantics=query
    doc="A short description from class, habitat, legs, covering, food and abilities."

    inputs=kids.animals.animal.diet
    inputs=kids.animals.animal.food

files.legend.sop:
@legend.kids.arith core.legend
    namespace=kids.arith
    version=0.1.0
    imports=core

    doc="Counting things people have, events that change the counts, totals, comparisons and bare arithmetic"

@kids.arith.holding core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="Someone has a number of items of one kind. A statement sets the count; later events change it."
    example="Tom has 5 apples."
    negative="Tom likes apples."

@kids.arith.holding.owner core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who has them?"

@kids.arith.holding.item core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What kind of thing is it?"

@kids.arith.holding.count core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many are there?"
    observe=true
    compute=true

@kids.arith.change core.type
    extends=core.event
    doc="Something happens to the number of items someone has. Events are applied in dialog order (core.seq)."
    example="Ana gives Tom 3 apples."

@kids.arith.change.who core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who is it about (who gives, gets, eats, loses, buys or breaks)?"

@kids.arith.change.to core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who receives the items?"

@kids.arith.change.item core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What kind of thing is it?"

@kids.arith.change.count core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many items are involved?"

@kids.arith.give core.type
    extends=kids.arith.change
    doc="One person gives some items to another person: who gives, to receives."
    example="Ana gives Tom 3 apples."

@kids.arith.receive core.type
    extends=kids.arith.change
    doc="Someone gets, receives or finds some items."
    example="Tom finds 2 marbles."

@kids.arith.eat core.type
    extends=kids.arith.change
    doc="Someone eats some items."
    example="Tom ate 2 apples."

@kids.arith.lose core.type
    extends=kids.arith.change
    doc="Someone loses some items."
    example="Mia lost 3 marbles."

@kids.arith.buy core.type
    extends=kids.arith.change
    doc="Someone buys some items (only the counts are tracked here, not the money)."
    example="Ben buys 4 pencils."

@kids.arith.break core.type
    extends=kids.arith.change
    doc="Someone breaks some items."
    example="Sam broke 2 pencils."

@kids.arith.total core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="How many items of one kind there are altogether, over everybody or over two named people."

@kids.arith.total.item core.key

@kids.arith.total.who1 core.key

    card=one
    ask="Who is the first person to count?"

@kids.arith.total.who2 core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who is the second person to count?"

@kids.arith.total.count core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many are there altogether?"
    compute=true

@kids.arith.leader core.type
    extends=core.state

@kids.arith.leader.item core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What kind of thing is it?"

@kids.arith.leader.who1 core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who is the first person to compare?"

@kids.arith.leader.who2 core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who is the second person to compare?"

@kids.arith.leader.winner core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who has more?"
    compute=true

@kids.arith.gap core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="How many more (or fewer) items of one kind the first person has than the second."
    example="How many more apples does Tom have than Ana?"

@kids.arith.gap.item core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What kind of thing is it?"

@kids.arith.gap.who1 core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who is the first person?"

@kids.arith.gap.who2 core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who is the second person?"

@kids.arith.gap.diff core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="What is the difference between the two counts?"
    compute=true

@kids.arith.verdict core.type

    doc="Yes or no: does the first person have more items than the second?"
    example="Does Tom have more apples than Ana?"

@kids.arith.verdict.item core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What kind of thing is it?"

@kids.arith.verdict.who1 core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who is the first person?"

@kids.arith.verdict.who2 core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who is the second person?"

@kids.arith.verdict.answer core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Is it yes or no?"
    compute=true

@kids.arith.has core.type

@kids.arith.has.owner core.key

    card=one

    value=atom
    card=one

@kids.arith.has.answer core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Is it yes or no?"
    compute=true

    card=one

@kids.arith.calc.a core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="What is the first number?"

@kids.arith.calc.b core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="What is the second number?"

@kids.arith.calc.result core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="What is the result?"
    compute=true

@kids.arith.half core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="Half of a number."
    example="What is half of 10?"

@kids.arith.half.n core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="Which number?"

@kids.arith.half.result core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="What is half of it?"
    compute=true

@kids.arith.double core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="Double a number."
    example="What is double 6?"

@kids.arith.double.n core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="Which number?"

@kids.arith.double.result core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="What is double it?"
    compute=true

files.legend.sop:
@legend.kids.shapes core.legend
    namespace=kids.shapes
    version=0.1.0
    imports=core
    imports=kids.common
    doc="Flat shapes, colors and the colors of everyday things"

@kids.shapes.shape core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="A flat shape and how many sides and corners it has."
    example="A hexagon has 6 sides."
    negative="A banana is yellow."

@kids.shapes.shape.name core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Which shape is it?"

@kids.shapes.shape.sides core.key
    value=integer
    ask="How many sides does it have?"

@kids.shapes.shape.corners core.key
    value=integer
    ask="How many corners does it have?"

@kids.shapes.shape.summary core.key
    value=string
    ask="What is it like?"
    compute=true
    observe=false

@kids.shapes.family core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="A shape is, or is not, a kind of shape (a square is a rectangle) or a round shape. holds=false is an explicit no."
    example="A square is a rectangle."

@kids.shapes.family.shape core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Which shape is asked about?"

@kids.shapes.family.kind core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Which kind of shape is asked about?"

@kids.shapes.family.holds core.key
    value=boolean
    ask="Is the shape of that kind?"
    compute=true

@kids.shapes.family.because core.key
    value=string
    ask="Why is it not so?"

@kids.shapes.color core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="A color and whether it is a primary or secondary color."
    example="Red is a primary color."

@kids.shapes.color.name core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Which color is it?"

@kids.shapes.color.kind core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Is it a primary, secondary or neutral color?"

@kids.shapes.color.is_kind core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Which kind of color is asked about?"
    compute=true
    observe=false

@kids.shapes.mix core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="Mixing two colors gives a third color."
    example="Red and yellow make orange."

@kids.shapes.mix.first core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Which is the first color?"

@kids.shapes.mix.second core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Which is the second color?"

@kids.shapes.mix.result core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Which color do they make?"
    compute=true

@kids.shapes.mix.recipe core.key
    value=string
    ask="Which colors make it?"
    compute=true
    observe=false

@kids.shapes.thing core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="An everyday thing: its typical colors and the flat shape it looks like. Several wires may describe the same thing."
    example="A banana is yellow."
    example="A clock is a circle."

@kids.shapes.thing.name core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Which thing is it?"

@kids.shapes.thing.color core.key
    value=atom
    ask="What color is it usually?"
    card=many
    compute=true

@kids.shapes.thing.shape core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Which shape does it look like?"

@kids.shapes.thing.article core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Which article goes with the name (a, an, the or none)?"

@kids.shapes.thing.is_color core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Which color is asked about?"
    compute=true
    observe=false
